framing.privateInput: raw UTF-8 bytes including all whitespace and LF; <=4096
framing.handoffSubtree: compact ensure_ascii=false UTF-8 encoding of handoff object only; <=8192
framing.optInOuter: raw complete per-destination stdout frame including whitespace and LF; <=1048576
framing.optInFanout: at most32 destinations before effect and aggregate stdout <=34603008 bytes; no normalization of ordinary legacy mode
framing.lexicalScope: new-schema subtrees only; legacy native sibling numeric tokens follow their existing rules
framing.oversizedHandoff: preserve independently valid matching native snapshot; no ACK promotion and no resubmission

receiptSchema.duplicateProof: original epoch/correlation/generation/receiptId plus constant-time original capability hash proof
receiptSchema.duplicateExpiryException: only return retained already committed receipt; deny revoked/quarantined/detail-expired authority

operatorConfirmationSchema.eventSemantics: new current attestation, not retroactive receipt timing proof
